# Jay Daftari

> Jay Daftari is a computer scientist and Gen AI engineer trained in AI and machine learning at New York University (MS, Computer Engineering). Jay builds agentic AI systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM tooling, most recently for legal teams at Lina Law and Wequity.

Portfolio: https://jaydaftari.github.io/

## Experience

- Lina Law, Gen AI Engineer (May 2026 to Oct 2026, remote): owned end-to-end features on a Next.js/React, TypeScript, Python and PostgreSQL (Supabase) stack; built agentic AI workflows that cut legal drafting and review cycles from weeks to a couple of hours; built a real-time collaborative document editor with Claude integration; built LLM-agent observability tooling that reconstructs each run's reasoning and tool calls from an append-only event log.
- Wequity, Gen AI Engineer (Feb 2026 to May 2026, remote): built AI agent pipelines with retrieval and multi-model routing (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini) on FastAPI and GCP for Nora, Wequity's legal AI platform.
- Vicktoria, Software Engineer (Nov 2025 to May 2026): built Vicktoria, an AI chat platform with an ID-based RAG API (FastAPI, LangChain, PostgreSQL/pgvector).
- NYC Department of Environmental Protection, Summer Graduate Intern (from Jun 2025, New York): SQL, Power BI, Python.
- New York University, Course Assistant (Jan 2025 to May 2025): open-source course development in Python and C++.
- IDFC First Bank, Application Engineer (Mar 2022 to Aug 2024, Bengaluru): React and React Native apps impacting 20M customers; UPI and video KYC features; 97% unit test coverage; Grafana and Prometheus monitoring.
- VIT Center of Advanced Data Science, Research Intern (Jul 2021 to Aug 2021, Chennai): explainable machine learning for water quality (90% accuracy, LIME and SHAP).
- Premware Services India LLP, MEAN Stack Developer (Feb 2021 to Mar 2021, Surat): real-time backend for Surati Taxi.

- Gradient Analysis for Edge Deployment: gradient statistics that guide pruning and gradient prediction (PyTorch)
- Efficient Fine-Tuning of RoBERTa with LoRA (Python)
- NYC MTA Ridership Dashboard: analytics and forecasting for 5+ years of NYC subway ridership (PySpark, Streamlit)
